dct_description_sm: The dataset has two components:  (1) Logs in Bogs: The overall goal is to reconstruct the Neoglacial climate of Labrador by using submerged subfossil wood (dated to mid-late Holocene) from ponds currently above treeline in the Labrador highlands.  We expect to generate an annual-resolution reconstruction of temperature and/or precipitation from tree-rings, locked into time by radiocarbon dates, that signify what the climatic conditions were like when treeline was higher than at present.  (2) Logs in Rivers: All of the main river systems draining central Labrador contain subfossil wood in raised terrace sediments.  The age of the wood spans hundreds to thousands of years before present.  Dendrochronological analysis will provide an opportunity to construct a late Holocene master tree-ring chronology for several species in central Labrador.
dct_title_s: Subfossil wood collection from central Labrador
